profile.headline: Big Data and AI @ Hyundai
profile.jobTitle: Software Engineer III - Big Data & AI

positions.title: Software Engineer III - Big Data & AI
Software Engineer I - Enterprise Data Platform
positions.description:
Building a new enterprise data platform utilizing Kubernetes and Helm to orchestrate multiple tools like Airflow, Jupyter, Ranger, Superset, and Spark
- Big Data Service Management: Manage data pipeline for the bank’s most critical data including risk, treasury and finance data. Updated pyspark version from 3.1.1 to 3.4.1. Wrote pyspark scripts to cover use cases of the bank’s development team including ETL with various file types.
-Build developer efficiency tools by writing custom Airflow Operators to standardize Spark and ETL development and help solve challenging data integration problems.
-Data Observability with Airflow: Created  interpretable visualizations and wrote Airflow DAGs to collect observability metrics of the bank’s data platform and infrastructure like access control policies and PII violations.

positions.title: Pega Decisioning Architect II
positions.description:
-Create Portfolio Growth, Fraud, and Marketing strategies to increase revenue and reduce losses for the bank
-Migrated from Pega version 8.1 to 8.5. 
-Develop validation scripts in Python to increase accuracy of strategies and campaigns

positions.title: Data Analyst
positions.description:
-Built a reporting system for paying out streaming and sync royalties using Python and PostgreSQL  based on data from streaming services like Spotify and Apple Music.
-Coordinated with the team to make necessary pivots by creating dashboards using Tableau and SQL to show key metrics and identify what customers liked and disliked about our product.
-Define and create automated test scripts using Selenium, Tavern, and Behave (a Behavior Driven Development Framework).
-Diagnose issues and partner with development teams to resolve bugs. Provide engineers with details like replication steps and application logs.

positions.title: Business Operations
positions.description: Manage customer service, inventory, and sales data for Los Angeles based rapper Dumbfoundead’s and celebrity chef Roy Choi’s online store. Generated over $100,000 in annual sales through e-commerce platform Shopify.

positions.title: Student Manager at Cal Men's Basketball
positions.description:
-Tracked stats to quantify player hustle and administered a shot chart program for statistical analysis
-Supported recruiting data in Excel
-Scheduled, coordinated and ensured over 10 recruiting visits ran smoothly. The team was able to successfully recruit NBA star Jaylen Brown currently a member of the Boston Celtics

volunteerExperiences.description:
-Run A/B Tests with Google Ads to maximize website visits and increase click through rate.
-Built site with Squarespace https://www.vessellv.org

projects.title: Sponsor Management Tool - Black Fire Innovation
projects.description: Built a web app for Black Fire Innovation to manage its relationships with sponsors, vendors, donations, and contacts using AWS Honeycode and Lambda.

testScores.name: SOA/CIA: Exam P (Probability)
testScores.description: Passed the first Actuarial Exam (Exam P) in probability covering "fundamental probability tools for quantitatively assessing risk".
